description: This file defines a class '_Settings' for managing application configuration settings loaded from environment variables, primarily for database connection, security, and CORS configuration. It initializes settings with default values and parses environment variables, including a method for converting comma-separated strings into a list.

classes.description: A class that encapsulates application configuration settings loaded from environment variables, including database URI, JWT configuration, CORS origins, and optional indexes file path.
